Consonantal i

Theme

Latin word

pendeō

pendeō, pendēre, pependī

verb, second conjugation: with ex and the ablative

depend on (literally, hang from); hang

In this lexicon

  • depend

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Parad. 2.17: pendet ex fortūnā; Cic. de Or. 2.107: ex quō verbō … tōta illa causa pendēbat

  • hang

    the recommended word · classical

Examples

  • cui spēs omnis et ratiō et cōgitātiō pendet ex fortūnā, huic nihil potest esse certī

    a man whose every hope, plan and thought depends on fortune can be sure of nothingCic. Parad. 2.17

    In the entry for depend

  • id ille in tē positum esse putat mihique persuādet

    he thinks it depends on you, and he has convinced meCic. Fam. 9.25.3

    In the entry for depend

  • Quam multum interest quid ā quōque fīat!

    How much depends on who does a thing!Plin. Ep. 6.24.1

    In the entry for depend

  • sīc ignis nōn rēfert quam magnus sed quō incidat

    so with a fire, it depends not on how big it is but on where it fallsSen. Ep. 18.15

    In the entry for depend

  • prout locus inīquus aequusve hīs aut illīs, prout animus pugnantium est, prout numerus …, varia fortūna pugnae est

    depending on whether the ground favoured one side or the other, on the fighters’ spirit and on their numbers, the fortune of the fight variedLiv. 38.40.14
